pages.text: Overworld and Nether monsters remade by alchemists, with their weak points mended and more health; the Overworld ones fear no daylight. They are constructs of runestone, obsidian and crystal, each turning a magic circle of its own colour underfoot that blazes up and pours out glyphs as it hunts or casts. They are neither undead nor arthropods.$(br2)$(l)Drops$()$(li)What the vanilla monster drops$(li)Alchemical essence: 15%$(li)Affix accessory recipes: 10%

pages.title: Arcana I
pages.text: Each creation has one signature spell: when it is ready and you are in reach it first draws a warning circle, then strikes.$(br)$(li)$(l)Ghoul, Rune Slam$(): the circle closes round it, then the gauntlet falls: 7 damage, thrown and slowed within 3.5 blocks$(li)$(l)Archer, Starfall$(): a circle under you, then six arrows rain down$(li)$(l)Weaver, Soul-thread$(): yanks you to its mandibles, slowed and poisoned$(li)$(l)Creeper, Chain Sigils$(): every blast leaves three rune mines round you that go off in turn

pages.title: Arcana II
pages.text: $(li)$(l)Strider, Rift Strike$(): opens a circle behind you, steps through and stabs: 1.5 times its blow, blinding$(li)$(l)Pyre Wraith, Pyre Sigil$(): a circle of flame under you erupts: 6 damage, 5 s alight, tossed up$(li)$(l)Soulbag, Soul Gaze$(): a 2 s beam that drains you to heal it; break line of sight to break it$(li)$(l)Witherbone, Spectral Cleave$(): a 110 degree sweep, 8 damage, Wither II, knockback$(li)$(l)Magma Core, Meteor Slam$(): leaps at you and erupts where it lands: 7 damage, fire, knockback
Faster; never drowns or turns into a drowned; always breaks doors on Hard.
Not afraid of wolves, never freezes into a stray; leads its shots and barely misses.
Stays hostile by day; its bite slows and poisons.
Survives its own blast and can blow again 5 s later, without breaking blocks; not afraid of cats, and keeps walking while the fuse burns.
Water and rain do not hurt it; it does not flee the daylight.
$(l)Nether$(). Water, rain and snowballs do not hurt it; twice the health. Roams the wastes, the basalt deltas and the crimson forests.
$(l)Nether$(). No fireball hurts it, not even its own sent back; four times the health, and between its great fireballs it sprays a fan of three small ones.

$(l)Nether$(). Only two blocks tall, so two-high tunnels do not stop it; no undead, half knockback, unafraid of wolves, its wither twice as strong; one in four shoots burning arrows. Most common in soul sand valleys.
$(l)Nether$(). Always full grown, and never splits into little cubes when it dies; leaps twice as often, with more health. Most common in basalt deltas.

pages.title: Creation Materials
pages.text: Killed by a player, each creation has a 35% chance (+10% per Looting level) to drop its own material, used in the charm, world core, origin orb and truth essence recipes:$(li)Zombie: Runic Flesh$(li)Skeleton: Etched Bone$(li)Spider: Starlit Silk$(li)Creeper: Volatile Core$(li)Enderman: Phase Pearl$(li)Blaze: Rune Ember$(li)Ghast: Spirit Tear Crystal$(li)Wither Skeleton: Withered Soul Shard$(li)Magma Cube: Molten Gel
